verdict.rationale: Twilio documents sending SMS through one Messaging API, usable over HTTPS or SDKs (twilio-docs-19, twilio-docs-25), alongside Phone Numbers APIs for buying and managing numbers (twilio-docs-14). Developers corroborate using it for SMS (twilio-comm-10, twilio-comm-15), and handling incoming SMS is implied by a TwiML bin complaint (twilio-comm-11). Delivery status callbacks are never explicitly documented; Event Streams' unified event feed (twilio-docs-8) is only adjacent. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-message delivery status callbacks (statusCallback webhooks), first-party docs on receiving inbound SMS via webhook on a number.
